items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...According to Thomas Cusack's Jelly Roll Morton discography... [INTERVIEWEE] Cusack was an Irishman. Did he come over here and do his research?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Steady Roll is not in the History of Jazz at Riverside. That's an error. Oh, it is not? No. There is a listing. It's Big Fat Hand. And they list the number of Steady Roll, but I've checked it with the other Big Fat Hand. And that's what it is. It's not Steady Roll at all. I don't have Steady Roll. I don't know what it is. Well, now, this is... But I think it's unlikely that Morton's on it. I think they're probably right.
